# Expense report

1. First line: `EXPENSE REPORT · <trip or month>`.
2. One Markdown table with exactly these columns: `Date | Item | Category | Amount`, one row per receipt.
3. Last line: `Total: <currency><amount>`.

No other text."}

| Date | Item | Category | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|

| Nov 3 | Client dinner | Meals | $96.40 |
| Nov 3 | Taxi | Ground Transportation | $23.10 |

Total: $416.00
